script.title: FINDING YOUR RIDESHARE PICKUP
script.scene_zh: 機場航廈 · 找網約車
script.story_hook: A passenger waits at the wrong terminal for a rideshare.
script.intro_zh: 乘客在錯的航廈等網約車。
script.welcome_en: Hello and welcome back! Today we're finding a rideshare pickup.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，歡迎回來！今天我們要找到網約車的上車點。
script.outro: That's it for today! Listen again and keep practicing.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！再聽一次，繼續練習。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each sentence together, one by one.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來一句一句一起跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young Black woman in her early twenties with long braided hair, wearing an oversized denim jacket over a white tee, rolling a small wheeled suitcase behind her
script.char_b_description: a laid-back Latino man in his forties with short dark hair and a trimmed mustache, wearing a navy zip hoodie, a phone mount glowing on the dashboard beside him

Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗網約車英文｜站錯航廈・確認末四碼・走到五號門｜聽完就會叫車｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
在機場叫了網約車，卻發現自己站在錯的航廈？
司機找不到你、行程又快取消，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進機場外的網約車上車區，跟著乘客與司機一通電話，從報位置、確認末四碼，到順利找到那輛銀色車。

你會聽到：
🚕 問上車點：例如 “Could I be at the wrong terminal?”、“Where are pickups?”。
📱 確認身分：例如 “Can you confirm the last four digits?”、“It ends in 2-0-9.”。
🧭 找到車與上車：例如 “I'm the silver car.”、“Hop in — you're all matched.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次落地叫車，記得先深呼吸——對話的每一步，你都會說了！
script.thumbnail_action: waving at a silver car from the curb

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, um, are you the car at Terminal B?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʌm ɑr ju ðə kɑr ət ˈtɜrmənəli bi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，呃，請問你是停在B航廈的那輛車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, but I don't see you around here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeə bʌt aɪ doʊnt si ju əˈraʊnd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 是我，但我在這附近沒看到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Could I be at the wrong terminal?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ kʊd aɪ bi æt ðə rɔŋ ˈtɜrmənəl/
dialogue.zh: 糟了，我會不會站在錯的航廈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That happens a lot — pickups are at B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈhæpənz ə lɑt ˈpɪkˌʌpz ɑr ɑt bi/
dialogue.zh: 這常常發生——上車點在B航廈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is Door five? My ride cancels soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɪz dɔr faɪv maɪ raɪd ˈkæn·səlz sun/
dialogue.zh: 五號門遠嗎？我的行程馬上要取消了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two minutes. Please walk to Door five.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tu ˈmɪn·ɪts pliz wɔk tə dɔr faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 只要兩分鐘，請走到五號門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I see a blue pickup sign. Yes!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ si ə blu ˈpɪkˌʌp saɪn jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我看到藍色的上車牌了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one. I'm the silver car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn aɪm ðə ˈsɪl·vər kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 就是那個。我是那輛銀色車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I see you now — right at the curb.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ si ju naʊ raɪt æt ðə kɜrb/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我現在看到你了，就在路邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you confirm the last four digits, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju kən·ˈfɜrm ðə læst fɔr ˈdɪdʒ·ɪts pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請確認一下手機末四碼好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɪt ɛndz ɑn tu oʊ naɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you're all matched. Hop in!
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，資料相符，快上車！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for waiting, and sorry again.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fər ˈweɪ·tɪŋ ənd ˈsɔ·ri əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你等我，也再次跟你抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries. The app says downtown, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜ·riz ði æp sɛz ˈdaʊnˌtaʊn raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。應用程式顯示是去市區，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, downtown, near the Grand Hotel.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy trip. We'll be there in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈi·zi trɪp wil bi ðɛr ɪn tɛn ˈmɪn·ɪts/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds great. I really appreciate your help.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡreɪt aɪ ˈrɪ·li əˈpri·ʃiˌeɪt jɔr hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很好，真的很謝謝你的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure! Sit back and relax.
